newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar stays quiet, rangebound.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar stays quiet, rangebound.

text.p: LIFFE sugar futures remained rangebound in Wednesday afternoon trading.
Trade was light, with May dominating volume.
By 1643 GMT May was 10 cents lower on the day at $306.30, having spent the day between a low of $305.60 and a high of $306.90.
May volume was 690 lots of a total 936 by that time.
"It's all pretty well in pre-easter holiday mode," one trader said.
There was no physical news affecting the market, he said. Trading was entirely technical, aping New York, which was also stuck in a tight range.
